fields.name: User
fields.evidence: ecl::splitscreen::GetActiveFullscreenTurnUser (EoCClient.dll+0x84A1A0, returns class net::UserID) finds the turn-order entity, fetches this component and returns its first 4 bytes as the UserID. macOS default constructor stores one 32-bit register at +0 (str w0, [x23]). Live: 1 instance during a fight, value 1.

open_questions: Member name is ours; the Toolkit only shows that the 4 bytes are returned as net::UserID.
